subject: Re: CaR kickoff — open-vocabulary segmentation without training data
body:
Status before I'm out next week.

Demo endpoint: live on Shipyard since May 14, GPU-backed so full SAM refinement is on. Early users are throwing genuinely weird queries at it ("scaffolding", "wet pavement") and mask quality is holding up — the training-free pitch is landing.

Evals (Gustavo): reproduced the release configs on three of the five benchmark datasets so far; numbers within 0.5 mIoU of published. Two remaining datasets blocked on data prep, Bilal's on it.

Risk/trade-off for the batch API: the recurrent loop's latency scales with query-set size. At 50 concept queries per image we're at 3.8s/image on an A100 — fine for batch, not for anything interactive. Recommendation: ship batch-only in this window, and I'll write up the loop-truncation experiment (2 iterations vs 3 costs ~0.7 mIoU but halves latency) as the Q3 interactive path.

Carmen
